why_this_matters: These are deliberately NOT seed_dois. OpenAlex holds no references and no citers for any of the three arXiv records, so seeding from them would expand nothing -- and seeding would also make recall against them trivially 100%. Kept as a gold set, they measure whether the queries alone find this literature.
